text:
About two or three years ago, when I wanted to get braces, I visited many places. From clinics with huge advertising signs along the way to those near my condo, I thought it would be better to be close if I had to come often.

I started with a large, modern-looking clinic, then medium-sized ones, and several small ones. The prices weren't much different, until I almost didn't go to the last one – I was too tired. It was the smallest and looked the oldest (it seemed like it'd been around for a long time). I just went in to ask about the price, but the staff suggested I talk to the doctor; he was there and the consultation was free. I was surprised and hesitant because I didn't want to make a decision right away.

The doctor was kind and lovely, and the price was comparable to the other clinics. I was won over when the doctor said, "You're a beautiful person, Ms. Moo. You'll be even more beautiful if you get braces." That's what made me decide to pay the deposit immediately! 555

And the doctor didn't disappoint. It's a small but warm clinic. The doctors here are patient and kind to everyone, even if I'm sometimes naughty and don't take care of my teeth regularly. None of their words hurt my feelings. Not only is the clinic highly skilled, but they also have a great understanding of customer psychology.

In addition, the clinic is decorated with beautiful framed pictures on the walls. Each visit features a different set of plants and flowers, creating a refreshing atmosphere. Even the exterior boasts meticulously arranged small potted gardens along the roadside.

As someone who enjoys gardening, I can see the effort and care that goes into achieving such results.

Today, a staff member from the clinic asked me to review their clinic, and I gladly obliged. My experience working in the five-star hotel industry reflects the exceptional service mindset of this small clinic.

This is a business run with genuine care and a true customer satisfaction! 🌷❤️👍
